title: Artificial Intelligence, Deepfake, and Fabricated Content: The Shield of Critical Thinking
summary: Deepfake, AI-generated images, and fake news—these can no longer be distinguished by sight alone. The rule is: (1) Is the source official/trusted? (2) Is there another independent source confirming it? (3) Does it provoke anger/fear/urgency? (Three signs of deception). Tools: Google Reverse Image Search, InVID, the platform’s official website.
try_this: This week: Choose a suspicious video or image—use Google Lens and Reverse Image Search together, and look for the original source. Discuss: How did you uncover the fabrication?
reflection_prompts: Has your child become more cautious about sharing?

review_defects.arabic: هل أصبح ابنك أكثر حذراً في المشاركة؟
review_defects.english: Has your child become more cautious about sharing?
review_defects.why: The Arabic uses 'ابنك' (your son), specifying a male child, while the English uses the gender-neutral 'your child', losing the original gender specificity.
